description: Checkpoint for the Daily Code Review routine. Records the last commit on the default branch (main) that has been reviewed. The next run diffs main from this SHA forward. Update after each run.

lastRun.notes:
23 commits / 124 files (~4.6k insertions, ~952 deletions). Every commit in the range is the merged IMPLEMENTATION of an already-tracked, now-Done ticket, so review focused on new defects in the delivered implementations (same posture as the 2026-09-15 run). Largest net-new surface: eec2ef0 (ADS-1270) weekly-digest email feature (~1k lines new: jobs/weekly-digest.ts, email/preferences.ts consent helpers, grpc/applications-client.ts + pets-client.ts fan-out, pets ListFavoritesForUser RPC). Reviewed the digest end-to-end by hand; the other five substantive commits (7275fbb rescue tenant scoping/ADS-1338, b97c9bc applications shared-scheduler refactor/ADS-1330, fa106f0 gateway Redis readiness/ADS-1327, 762f01e cms image-url validation/ADS-1350, ced3ac1 observability PII redaction/ADS-1344) via a parallel adversarial review agent. Remaining commits were docs/CI/chore (bee0761, 0b2a6ca, 65bd7b6, 5a285f0, 6e914b9 docs; 772245e, c1be210 CI = DevEx territory; a7a7307, 47a5dbb chore; 07974ae glitchtip secrets = Security territory) or already-tracked security fixes (7c2f240 LIKE-escape/ADS-1349, c87daba pet-image-url/ADS-1343, d985a41 CSRF-Bearer-skip/ADS-1327, 4258719 AV-scan-fail-closed/ADS-1339, 7103c14 permission-constants/ADS-1340, 4e366ae docker-override/ADS-1335). Filed 2 findings:

- ADS-1351 (Medium/Bug): global log redactor over-masks operational fields. ced3ac1's PII_KEY_PATTERN (packages/observability/src/redact.ts:52) uses bare 'name' and 'address' substrings, which also match jobName/eventName/fileName/hostName/queueName/ipAddress/remoteAddress etc.; maskPiiValue reduces each to its first char. Live now across every service using the shared logger. Concrete: @adopt-dont-shop/scheduler logs {name: job.name} → 'a***', so an operator can't tell which scheduled job failed. Over-masking, not a leak (logger did no PII masking pre-ced3ac1). Verified against source.

- ADS-1352 (Medium/Bug): weekly-digest 'hard consent' gate is opt-out by default. isWeeklyDigestConsented (services/notifications/src/email/preferences.ts:161) returns true for a missing email_preferences row AND for the schema default (digest_frequency default 'weekly' in migration 006, is_email_enabled default true). The run targets the whole auth active-user cohort, so recipients = every active non-unsubscribed user regardless of opt-in. Latent behind WEEKLY_DIGEST_ENABLED (default false) — fix before the flag is flipped. UK GDPR/PECR + domain-reputation risk. The in-diff consent logic is the finding; the pre-existing default is cited as context. Verified against source.

Systemic note: both findings continue the established 'the delivered implementation of a tracked ticket introduces a new narrow defect' pattern (2026-09-15's ADS-1345/1346; before that ADS-1332/1333). ADS-1351 is an over-correction in a Security-tracked hardening fix (ADS-1344); ADS-1352 is a consent-semantics gap in a delivered feature (ADS-1270).

Agent-confirmed CLEAN (no new defect): 7275fbb (requirePermission tenant scope + admin override complete, no cross-tenant path), b97c9bc (shared scheduler behaviourally identical to the deleted fork — same nextRunAt/claim/runOnStart; only addition an unused skipClaim flag), fa106f0 (test-only; redisOptional shipped earlier), 762f01e (forked isSafeImageUrl byte-equivalent to gateway canonical; enforced at all 4 create/update boundaries).

Considered but NOT filed (below the signal bar / other-routine territory): eec2ef0 adds 'reminder' to EMAIL_WORTHY_TYPES globally and NOT behind WEEKLY_DIGEST_ENABLED, so all REMINDER+EMAIL notifications become email-eligible and bypass category-level gating — but reminders are legitimately emailable, the digest is currently the only producer, and channel-level is_email_enabled still gates them, so defensible design not a bug; the digest's last_digest_sent UPDATE is decoupled from the notification insert so a failed update mis-counts sent/failed but only affects bookkeeping metrics (last_digest_sent is not a gating column); no audit event emitted when a run sends nothing or all-fail (acknowledged pattern, matches email-queue-retention). Security-routine (07974ae glitchtip, and the ADS-1338/1339/1340/1342/1343/1344/1349/1350 fixes themselves) and DevEx/CI-policy (772245e, c1be210, a7a7307) territory left to those routines per guardrails 3 and 5.
